column1: # Code lists the number builders draw from (curated 2026-11-11, Milestone 5), beside the lists copied
# at build time from id-generator (Chinese counties, Russian regions, Romanian counties, Thai provinces)
# and from GLEIF (LEI issuers). weight: relative; extra: per list (see each block).
# in-state: the GST state codes (CBIC, GST state code list) with the RoC letters of the CIN (MCA) in
# extra; weight: about the share of companies registered in the state (MCA, rounded, as known in 2025).
# hu-county: the area code ending a Hungarian tax number (NAV): 02-20 the counties, 41-44 Budapest's
# directorates, 51 the large taxpayers' directorate; weight: about the share of enterprises.
# de-court: the local courts that keep the commercial register (Handelsregister), by Land (the Land
# justice ministries' lists; Baden-Württemberg keeps it at four courts, Berlin at Charlottenburg);
# weight: about the court's share of registered firms; extra: about the highest HRB number issued, or
# lo-hi where the Land numbers in a block (Baden-Württemberg from 700001, Lower Saxony from 200001,
# Thuringia from 500001). Tostedt keeps the register of the Stade district.
